status: BSON reader integration verified; only two Brotli conformance cases remain failing
change: Shared convertBsonValues supplies owned flat and nested conversion; parser callbacks supply public/fallback conversion. Dynamic BSON maps use logical vector construction, including dictionary and packed leaves. Public normalization preserves map member presence. Schema validation accepts BYTE_ARRAY BSON and rejects incompatible physical types. Existing unsupported nested tests now use INTERVAL, preserving their rejection assertions. The old BSON capability assertion was updated after real-reader and dictionary support was proven.

validation.fixture: Actual bson.parquet verifies expected member presence and nulls in public and owned results. Owned outputs stay charged until release.
validation.dictionary: Both PLAIN and deprecated PLAIN_DICTIONARY dictionaries decode through shared conversion; exact peak succeeds, one byte below rejects atomically. Packed nested BSON leaves have equivalent boundary coverage.
validation.workerR2: Local workerd/Miniflare native R2 binding, four concurrent owned-result queries, 64/128 MiB shared pools, 1 MiB per-query caps, cold/warm shared cache, early iterator return, cache eviction to zero. This is runtime/storage-binding validation, not a deployed Cloudflare benchmark.
validation.errors: Malformed second logical value rolls back the whole BSON conversion array; wrong physical BSON annotations reject before decoding.

limits: Decimal128 preserves exact bytes in a tagged logical value; SQL decimal128 arithmetic is not implied.
Public borrowed reader results transfer to caller-managed JS storage; tracked query limits are not a total VM heap cap.
Brotli capability and oversized-value admission remain open, along with broader performance audit gaps.
